traps.description: orders-api v4.12.0 shipped 7 minutes before the errors with a heavy new export job, and a past incident blames a release; but requests stay fast for 5 minutes after the deploy, the errors start right after the pool limit drops to 5, and they continue after the export finishes

A long autovacuum on orders-db, a vacuum tuning change and a matching past incident suggest the database is slow; but orders-db CPU is low, it has 9 of 400 connections in use and its slowest query is 38 ms
